content.en_US: A very potent and reactive acid, made with [[nitric acid|Nitric Acid]] and [[pure buurmium|Buurmium]]. It can be used in a [[PUREX]] to purify buurmium more efficiently, or can be processed further into a [[light buurmium solution|Light Buurmium Solution]], which is required for Metastable Buurmium-2137.
